rust_desktop.rationale: The app-layer secure session substrate exists, but no audited native Bluetooth adapter or permission-gated radio flow is enabled; current ftnl-desktop-app.rs README (reviewed 2026-10-29) explicitly keeps native adapters disabled.

flutter_desktop.rationale: The Flutter secure session substrate exists, but native Bluetooth adapters, platform permissions, background pairing and unattended updates remain disabled pending the adapter acceptance gate; confirmed in the current ftnl-flutter README (reviewed 2026-10-29).
